info.title: STV Election API
info.description: API for Single Transferable Vote (STV) election system

400.description: Bad request - election is locked or invalid data

404.description: Election not found or config not found

400.description: Email not configured or invalid request

500.description: Internal server error or SMTP failure

400.description: Email not configured or token already sent

parameters.description: Token ID to send email to

400.description: Email not configured or token already sent
Invalid ballot data or voting period constraints

200.description: List of ballots for the election

get.summary: Get token info (without redeeming it) - voter can check if already redeemed

400.description: Token already redeemed or election closed

200.description: Election state with results if available

ranks.description: Ranked preferences as indices into the candidates list. None indicates no preference for that position.
Ranked preferences as indices into the candidates list

votes.description: Number of identical ballots with these rankings

header.description: Election metadata extracted from the log header

rounds.description: Sequential rounds of the counting process

CountingLogAction.description: An action taken during a counting round

candidate_counts.description: Candidate vote counts at the time of this action

stats.description: Election statistics at the time of this action

oneOf.description:
A candidate has been elected, with the reason
(`exceeds_quota` or `remaining`)

elect.description:
A candidate has been elected, with the reason
(`exceeds_quota` or `remaining`)

oneOf.description:
Surplus votes have been redistributed; the reason says how the
iteration ended (`elected`, `stable_surplus`, `low_surplus`)

iterate.description:
Surplus votes have been redistributed; the reason says how the
iteration ended (`elected`, `stable_surplus`, `low_surplus`)

oneOf.description:
A candidate has been defeated, with the reason
(`stable_surplus`, `low_surplus` or `remaining`)

defeat.description:
A candidate has been defeated, with the reason
(`stable_surplus`, `low_surplus` or `remaining`)

oneOf.description: A tie between candidates was broken by random selection

break_tie.description: A tie between candidates was broken by random selection

CountingLogActionType.description: The type of action performed during a counting round

withdrawn.description: Whether the candidate has withdrawn from the election

CountingLogCandidateCount.description:
Vote count for a single candidate at a point in the count.
Index-aligned with [`CountingLog::candidates`].

status.description: Candidate status at this point in the count

votes.description: Number of votes (as a decimal string)

CountingLogCandidateStatus.description: Status of a candidate during the count

CountingLogHeader.description: Election metadata extracted from the log header

seats.description: Number of seats to be filled

CountingLogStats.description: Aggregate election statistics at a point in the count

id.description: Index/ID of the candidate in the candidates list

ElectionConfig.description: ElectionConfig - what gets sent to the API (no sensitive info)

casted.description: Number of ballots that have been cast

potential_voters.description: Number of ballot tokens issued (potential voters)

oneOf.description: Election results (only available after election ends)

election.description: Sub-election for this group (filtered candidates and ballots)
